title: Finite time singularities in the Landau equation with very hard potentials
summary: We consider the inhomogeneous Landau equation with $γ\in (\sqrt{3},2]$ and construct smooth, strictly positive initial data that develop a finite time singularity. The $C^α$-norm of the distribution function blows up for every $α>0$, whereas its $L^{\infty}$-norm remains uniformly bounded.
